meaning_en: to make up for, to catch up on
definition_de: etwas, das man versäumt hat, später tun (Schlaf nachholen, eine Prüfung nachholen)
example_de: Nach der Rente wollten wir reisen und alles nachholen, was wir in jungen Jahren verpasst haben.
example_en: After retiring we wanted to travel and make up for everything we missed when we were young.
visual_idea: User's scene: a grey-haired couple with backpacks spreading their arms with joy above a fjord. Their age plus the adventure shows they are finally doing what they missed when young; the sentence names the missed years. Pairs with verpassen.
image_prompt: a grey-haired couple in their seventies with hiking backpacks standing on a rocky viewpoint high above a deep blue Norwegian fjord, both laughing and spreading their arms wide with joy, the woman holding a small camera, steep green mountains and a waterfall across the fjord, bright summer day
